title: Break Escape Scenario Schema
description: Schema for validating Break Escape scenario.json.erb files

startPosition.description: Optional tile coordinates where the player spawns in the startRoom. If omitted the player is placed at the room centre.

show_scenario_brief.description: When to show the scenario brief (e.g. 'on_resume')

disableAttacks.description: When true the player cannot attack: no punching, no interact/attack mode toggle, and no combat tutorial step. For non-combat scenarios such as the SIS serious games.

creditsTheme.description: Theme of the end-of-mission credits visualiser (public/break_escape/js/music/credits-theme.js). 'safetynet' (the default) is the SAFETYNET campaign debrief. 'cyber' is a generic cyber security incident review: the mission name and first subtitle credit line as headings, SIEM and matrix modes but no threat map, agency panel, classified stamp or track title. Each theme sets which visualiser modes are enabled.

creditsOverlay.description: Optional mission words for the safetynet credits overlay, replacing its generic filler. operation: the name in the header's OPERTN: row (stops the rotating operation names). ticker: the footer ticker, a string or an array of lines joined with the ██ separators. Either may be left out.

gameClock.description: Optional in-game clock: { "start": "Tue 07:30" } (or just the string). Clock displays (phone, command board, SIEM) then show this start time plus elapsed game time instead of the real wall clock. Elapsed game time resumes after a reload. rate: game minutes per real minute (default 1). anchors: [{ condition, time }] jump the clock forward when the condition first holds.

flags.description: Top-level VM flag data, keyed by VM name. Use ERB helper vm_flags_json() to populate.

lighting.description: Room lighting (systems/lighting.js). Off unless enabled. Rooms can override in their own 'lighting' block.

ambient.description: Lit ambient colour, e.g. '#c4cad8'. Lower is moodier.

darkAmbient.description: Ambient colour with the lights off, e.g. '#101424'.

music.description: Music system configuration. Events trigger music changes based on game events.

startItemsInInventory.description: Items that start in player inventory

mutuallyExclusiveGlobals.description: Sets of global variable names that can never be true at the same time. The onceOnly overlap check reads these so it does not report handlers as colliding in states the scenario keeps unreachable by construction.

oneOf.description: Object-valued globals are for the social systems' state (se_board_state, se_landing_pages, se_landing_drafts), default {}
Array-valued globals are for list state the social systems write, such as se_awareness_records, default []

rooms.description: Map of room IDs to room definitions

narrator.description: Optional narrator NPC that appears in multiple scenarios (e.g., for cutscenes or narration)

social.description: Social-engineering systems data (planning_notes/phishing_and_social_engineering/designs/00_data_contract.md §11). Closed: every block names the keys the engine or scripts/validate_social reads, so a mistyped key fails. Keys starting with _ are notes. Cross-references and values are linted by scripts/validate_social.rb.

readyToast.description: Body of the 'Ready to approach' toast. Optional: by default it is built from each ready target's channels (systems/social-intel.js readyToastText).

labels.description: Board wording; each defaults to today's text. progress is a template using {n} and {total}.

caseButton.description: The OSINT browser's board button (default 'Case file')

groups.description: Panels for non-person fact subjects (default: one 'company' panel titled Company). An intelFacts[].subject must be a social.people id or one of these subjects.

osint.description: The OSINT browser (design 02). Sites, their pages and selectable blocks, and the picked-lookup tools. Nothing in it is typed by the player.

profile.description: Which showIf/profile set the browser reads (for example 'student')

items.description: The landing-page builder (design 07). One record per buildable credential-harvest page. Fields are linted by scripts/validate_social/landing.rb (00 S11 lint field list). No form controls, no network, invented brands, .example hosts.

linkText.description: The address the mail client shows for the link, authored; the player never types it (host linted like a .example address)

targets.description: Per-target strictness keyed by a phishTargets id; { linkThreshold, minDomainTier, brandGate }. Each key must be a target that requires linkCredible.

label.description: The builder chip and the page heading, e.g. 'Session expired'.

button.description: The words on the page's drawn submit button, e.g. 'Sign in' or 'Reset password'. Default 'Sign in'; the label is never used as the button.

fieldLabels.description: Field id to on-screen label overrides (landing-page-labels.js)

strings.description: Feedback string overrides (landing-page-model.js); every value is linted as a string

conceptCards.description: social.conceptCards ids shown by the builder

address.description: A fictional .example address (00 S11 lint field list)

note.description: Authored capture note; holds no password value

kind.description: document, pdf, spreadsheet, archive, image or link; any other value draws as a document

checklistTiming.description: When the send checklist shows (mail-client-minigame.js _checklistTiming; default onSend). Linted by validate_social/options.rb

bodyMode.description: Body composition (design 01 §2 Body; mail-composer.js). templates (default): scored template parts only. freeText: the template parts plus one unscored free-text box; the templated slots still decide the result. Linted by validate_social/options.rb

freeTextFlavour.description: Alternate switch for the unscored free-text box (design 01 §2 Body); equivalent to bodyMode freeText. The box is shown when either is set. Its text is shown in the sent mail but never judged and never read by the ink (00 §13). Linted by validate_social/options.rb

awareness.description: Deployment settings the awareness episodes read (FUN_DECISIONS aw1, aw4, aw6). The host page's window.breakEscapeConfig.awareness wins key by key. Plain text only, at most 600 characters each

reportRoute.description: aw1: the organisation's own route to report a suspicious message, call or text, drawn in the debrief's 'How to report here' box under the Monday card. A string, or { heading, text }. Unset, an episode whose debrief.mondayCard is 'slot:customer_report_route' shows a generic 'find out how your organisation wants it reported' line. Never write a real organisation's route here unless it is that organisation's deployment

ruleOfThumb.description: aw4: one short rule shared by every debrief, shown above the Monday card. A string, or { heading, text }. Unset, nothing is shown

teamSize.description: aw6: the people on the learner's team, named in the debrief's team line

indicatorsIntro.description: Line above the indicators step; a default is shown when omitted

indicators.description: Optional indicators step (design 03). Each is shown only when a sent message carries its tell; the player marks it Block or Let through. Gates onCompleteGlobal only through a declared step it names

tell.description: A tell id on the sent record (senderTrust, senderAuth, linkCredible, urgencyCalibrated)

block.description: The right mark: true for Block, false for Let through

results.description: Which result panels the report shows; default all three (report-model.js)

strings.description: The report's fixed copy; each key defaults to the lab's wording (report-model.js DEFAULT_REPORT_STRINGS)

labelBy.description: role labels the results rows by role (report-model.js). Linted by validate_social/options.rb

timers.description: Optional timer system configuration for the scenario (array of timer objects)

socialInfluenceDisplay.description: Which influence UI shows (README AA): each key defaults to true; bar false also hides the number. Linted by validate_social.rb influence_display_lint

socialThresholdEffect.description: A threshold effect (social-influence.js _runEffect). setGlobal: global, value, clearOnRearm; toast: text; lockout: until, scope, recoverTo, alternativeRoute

until.description: lockout: {afterMinutes} or {global}; null is permanent (the validator then needs alternativeRoute)

mirrorToBehavior.description: true copies the influence to the person NPC's behaviour state (social-influence.js _mirror). Linted by validate_social/options.rb

emailRecord.description: A headless NPC record for the email channel; spread into an NPC record (scenario-npc-records.js), so any NPC field is accepted

emailReplyDelay.description: Seconds before an email reply arrives (default 20)

emailKnots.description: accountId -> knot name in the email story

alternativeRoute.description: Truthy when a lockout with no expiry has another way through (validator only)

gapString.description: Opt-in (intel-board-minigame.js): names only the gap; goalString then hides behind a 'Stuck?' disclosure

socialOsintBlock.description: An OSINT block, post, result or list item (osint-browser-minigame.js block renderer)

kind.description: heading|h, link, image, list, staff, field, post; anything else is plain text

showIf.description: A global name; the block shows only when it is true (osint-model.js)

src.description: image block: path relative to assets/ (for example social/osint/foo.png)

author.description: post block: a social.people id shown as the poster

path.description: Appended to the site's url in the address bar (the host stays the linted sites[].url)

url.description: A full address for this page, shown as typed; linted as a host like sites[].url
Host shown in the address bar exactly as authored; a fictional .example host (00 S11 lint field list)

card.description: social.conceptCards id shown with the site

domain.description: Shown as typed; ASCII unless trick is 'homograph' with a \u escape (00 S11)

browserDomain.description: The punycode (xn--) form, shown as a teaching contrast; equals the encoding of domain

name.description: Invented brand name; checked against the real-brand denylist

logo.description: Path of the brand's logo image; default assets/social/landing/logo-<brandId>.png

realDomain.description: A fictional .example host (00 S11 lint field list)

decoyWords.description: Allowlisted domain labels; each must pass the denylist

socialSeededMessage.description: A seeded message (mail-data.js normaliseSeeded; mail-scheduler.js). `from` is passed through whole

kind.description: document, pdf, spreadsheet, archive, image or link; any other value draws as a document

type.description: Matched to intelFacts provides[].type (name, address, date, document, ...)

stuck.description: Where-to-look pointer the composer shows under this blank while no evidence fills it, behind a 'Stuck?' disclosure (lab R15 N5). Names a source, never the value.

stuckUntil.description: Pointer shown under a blank that has options but not the right one (lab R16 N9): {target (phishTargets id, optional), value (option value that ends it), text}.

flags.description: P5-8: channel tells this wording carries (e.g. secrecy_or_bypass, borrowed_authority). Added to the send's tells, so the flip, the replayed defend card and the composer's red-flag meter all name them

requires.description: social.intelFacts ids that must all be held before this subject is offered (P3 N15)

requiresTemplate.description: P5-7: social.templates ids (usually pretexts) this subject fits. It is offered only while one of them is chosen, and choosing one makes it the subject; unbound subjects stay offered for any choice

hintsByFactor.description: factor id -> hint string or variants (phish-rules.js selectFactorHint). Linted by validate_social/options.rb

setGlobal.description: global name -> value, or one global name; the mail client sets the first to true on a landing

failMissed.description: Shown in place of fail when the send did not land; empty hides the line (advisory factors)
Shown in place of fail when the send did not land; empty hides the line (advisory factors)

mismatch.description: The name and address belong to different people (phish-rules.js judgeSender state 'mismatch')

failMissed.description: Shown in place of fail when the send did not land; empty hides the line (advisory factors)
Shown in place of fail when the send did not land; empty hides the line (advisory factors)
Shown in place of fail when the send did not land; empty hides the line (advisory factors)
Shown in place of fail when the send did not land; empty hides the line (advisory factors)
Shown in place of fail when the send did not land; empty hides the line (advisory factors)

socialTriageMessage.description: A triage message (triage-messages.js normaliseTriageMessage); kind playerSent reads targetId, fromMailbox, domainFrom and notes

critical.description: Awareness scoring: true makes Trust on this phish a critical miss whatever its kind; false makes it never one. Unset: Trust on a phish push, call or email is critical.

falseAlarmCost.description: Real items only (optional): one sentence on what reporting or deleting this real one would cost (a payment held up, a colleague left waiting). Shown after what made it safe on the result screen and the debrief (disc_visible).

correct.description: choice only: the verdict of the right option (it must score full marks for isPhish)

earlier.description: sms: earlier bubbles in the thread

choice.description: choice: an authored decision. Each option is scored as the built verdict it names (awareness profile); the right one is the option whose verdict equals truth.correct. Nothing is typed.

note.description: A line under the prompt, such as 'these are made up; no real password is typed'

audio.description: voicemail only: names the audio clip for the voicemail card. Ignored until the player control (P7-Z2) exists, so content can name its clip now

transcript.description: call (required) and voicemail (optional, else body): the lines spoken

certificate.description: The certificate check: who the certificate was issued to (a host name). It proves the connection is encrypted to that host, not that the host is the organisation it claims to be

note.description: Replaces the card's line on what the certificate does not prove

autofill.description: Whether the password manager filled the fields in. 'none' shows the 'did not fill this in' cue

socialAwarenessEpisode.description: An awareness episode (design 11 S5.1, PHASE7_PACKETS S2.1; the episode runner reads it). Linted by scripts/validate_social/awareness.rb. A defend-only episode uses id '<full id>_defend'. A check mission uses stages ['check'] and defend.stage 'pre' or 'post'.

brand.description: The neutral-skin wordmark (N8): drawn in CSS from logoText, accent is a CSS colour

variant.description: Optional on a check mission (stages ["check"]); required for the other two kinds (awareness.rb says so)

flipAftermath.description: ENG-01: after a landed attack the flip shows the victim's seat. items are authored inline: an 'email' (one read-only sent-items row) or a non-email kind (sms, voicemail, qr, page, call, push). Shown only when the attack landed

victimName.description: The colleague whose account is now in use

stepLabels.description: ENG-01: step-strip labels keyed by stage id; wins over strings.stepLabels

conclusionTaskId.description: The task the host NPC's mapping completes; passed to the triage starter

standalone.description: Default true. False makes the episode one beat in a bigger mission: awareness.rb then skips the missionConclusion, host-NPC and conclusionTaskId checks

attack.description: Read only by a full episode

landingPageId.description: A social.landingPages id whose targets lists attack.target. Launched by the 'build' stage (osint, build, write)

callId.description: A social.pretextNpcs callId. The write stage then places this pretext call instead of sending mail, so accountIds and defaultAccount are not needed

layout.description: Passed to the mail client: puts its narrow layout in a phone frame on any viewport

showRedFlagMeter.description: Reserved, not read: accepted but nothing reads it.

maxMessages.description: Reserved, not read: the runtime does not read it (the validator still wants 1 on a mail attack)

stage.description: Set on a check mission only

reportAlwaysVisible.description: Reserved, not read: accepted but nothing reads it.

callsFrom.description: A social.pretextNpcs callId whose knows ids the calls' claims resolve to. Omitted: any pretextNpcs entry's knows

calls.description: Role swap (11 N15, P7-P): calls the learner takes as the agent. Each becomes a 'call' message in the defend set (truth.isPhish = !genuine, truth.flags = tells). Linted by awareness.rb

label.description: What the card shows for this claim. Wins over the intelFacts provides label. Required in a defendOnly shell that has no pretextNpcs

concernForm.description: ENG-12: a reusable 'raise a concern' form that runs inside the defend stage, after any sortDrill and before the triage set (concern-form-minigame.js). The learner builds a report from fact chips (what, when, where, who) and may add one conclusion chip; the feedback favours facts over a verdict. Teaching only: it is never scored. Linted by awareness.rb.

guidance.description: The route to take, shown on the intro and under the feedback (who to tell, and that posting it in a chat is spreading it, not raising it)

minFacts.description: How many fact chips make a report (default 2)

strings.description: Wording over the form's defaults (concern-form-model.js DEFAULT_TEXT) and the runner's launchHeading, launchText and launchButton, keyed by line

sortDrill.description: ENG-11: a reusable sort drill that runs first inside the defend stage (sort-drill-minigame.js). Cards are sorted into 2 to 4 authored bins with the reason on screen. scored true marks each drop against the card's answer; false is teaching only and shows no mark. Linted by awareness.rb.

answerKeyProfile.description: Scored drills only: names the answer key the cards' answers come from (kept in the result)

alwaysScoresBin.description: Scored drills only: a bin id. Choosing it on a card it is not the answer to still earns a point (caution is never marked as nothing)

answer.description: A bin id, or a list of bin ids that are all accepted

locked.description: A deployment's overrides never change or drop this card

confirmed.description: false: never drawn (an organisation has not confirmed the card). Default true

new.description: Shown with a New badge, and first when drawRules.newFirst

drawCount.description: Draw this many cards from the confirmed bank (default: all of them)

strings.description: Wording over the drill's defaults (sort-drill-model.js DEFAULT_TEXT), keyed by line
Every learner-facing line of the episode, as data

flipDefenderLineByChoice.description: aw2: the flip's defender line per chosen pretext, keyed by the template id the learner picked (state.sent.templateId). A matching entry replaces flipDefenderLine for that branch; any other branch falls back to flipDefenderLine. Keys are social.templates ids

flipMontageByChoice.description: ENG-04: the montage flip's line per beat and option, { <beatId>: { <optionId>: string } }. The learner's own option shows when it has a line, else the beat's unsafe option's. Keys are awarenessEpisode.mistake beat and option ids. Full consequence episodes only (the defend-only shell has no flip)

flipMontageIntro.description: ENG-04: the line above the montage; default 'Here is where each of those choices led.'

sandbox.description: ENG-04: the consequence sandbox's own lines over its defaults (consequence-sandbox.js). progress may hold {n} and {total}

noBlameLine.description: The debrief's no-blame line. It shows only after a wrong verdict (a phish not caught, a real one deleted or complied with), never after missed ticks alone (P5-5/P5-15); after a critical miss noBlameLineCritical stands in for it

noBlameLineCritical.description: The no-blame line after a critical miss (the result has just said what it cost), so it must not claim nobody is marked down. Default: the engine's own line

defendIntro.description: Replaces the runner's fixed defend-stage intro, which talks about an inbox (wrong for a page or call set)

flipMissed.description: The flip's line after a send that did not land

flipLandedNoTells.description: The flip's line after a send that landed but has nothing to replay (no tells); falls back to flipMissed

flipMissedHeading.description: The flip's heading when nothing is replayed (a miss, or a landing with no tells); default 'Nothing to replay this time'

flipPageIntro.description: The flip's intro when it shows a built landing page

flipCallIntro.description: The flip's intro when it shows a pretext call

continue.description: The label of the Continue button

stages.description: Per-stage panel copy over the runner's fixed lines, keyed by stage id (brief, osint, build, write, mfa, mistake, flip, defend, debrief, check)

launchFailed.description: The notice when a stage's tool does not open; default 'That did not open. Close this window and try the kiosk again.'

stepLabels.description: Step-strip labels keyed by stage id

facilitator.description: Facilitator notes: one string per stage id (brief, osint, build, write, mfa, mistake, flip, defend, debrief, check) plus 'pause'

conceptPanel.description: A short concept panel for the debrief (E2: macros). A string, or { heading, text }, or an array of { heading?, text } for several panels (ENG-09b)

voicePanel.description: A short debrief panel on copied voices (E4, E7: concept level only). A string, or { heading, text }

debrief.description: mondayCard 'slot:customer_report_route' asks the debrief for the 'How to report here' box (social.awareness.reportRoute, else a generic line). noBlameLine is reserved, not read

mondayCard.description: 'slot:customer_report_route' is the only value the runner reads

mistake.description: ENG-04: the consequence stage of a consequence-flip episode (E11, E15, E16, E19, E20). The learner makes a few everyday choices in a sandbox (the consequence-sandbox scene), unscored; the flip then runs as a montage (flip.mode). Linted by awareness.rb: exactly one safe option per beat, flipBeat is a beat, absent on a defendOnly shell

scored.description: Always false; the sandbox is never scored

id.description: Stable beat id; the montage and strings.flipMontageByChoice key on it

situation.description: The on-screen prompt for this everyday choice

safe.description: True for the approved route; exactly one per beat

approvedRoute.description: Marks the single modelled best move (a safe option)

flipBeat.description: The beat whose branch heads the montage (aw2's one consequential choice); a beat id

flip.description: ENG-04: how the flip stage is drawn. mode 'montage' replays the consequence sandbox's choices as a montage (needs awarenessEpisode.mistake)

mfa.description: The mfa stage, passed to the authenticator scene (11 N11, P7-M; E3 decision E3-11). Two shapes, both linted by awareness.rb: a scripted stream ({ pushes, approvesAt }) or a learner decision ({ choice, pushTemplate, defenderNote }).

approvesAt.description: 'HH:MM' or a number: when the target taps approve

choice.description: Decision mode: the learner picks when (timing) and how many (count) before the burst plays.

at.description: 'HH:MM' or a number: the time on every prompt and the approval

outcome.description: Why this timing made the target approve

n.description: How many prompts this bucket sends (cards cap at 4, the rest collapse to a summary)

pushTemplate.description: Decision mode: the fields every generated prompt card shows.

defenderNote.description: Decision mode: the defender's control, shown last in the outcome

strings.description: Optional wording over the authenticator defaults (authenticator-minigame.js). In decision mode choice.intro and choice.confirm win over intro and confirm.

approved.description: The banner when the target taps Approve

wordmark.description: The app name in the title bar (default AUTH)

request.description: The question on each prompt card (default 'Are you trying to sign in?')

socialTriageActionLabel.description: Wording for one triage action: the button label, the past tense on the list badge, the button hint

socialTriageSet.description: An inbox triage set (design 05; triage-starter.js, inbox-triage-minigame.js)

realLabel.description: The noun for the genuine items in the result grid ("Real texts and notices"); default follows the queue's channels.

flagPlayerSent.description: Opt-in (inbox-triage-minigame.js): marks the player's own sends on the review flip; a string is the line shown, true uses a default

missedPhishLine.description: Opt-in (inbox-triage-minigame.js): the result card names the phish the learner trusted. Default off.

genuineFeedback.description: false hides the result screen's and debrief's lines on the real items (which were trusted, what made a flagged one safe). Default on.

resultCopy.description: Replaces the result screen's two follow-up lines (default: the mail-client and lab-sheet wording, or the awareness wording). {it} in weakest becomes it or them.

noFlags.description: When the learner named no flags

reportReplyFrom.description: The prefix on the reply shown after a correct report (default 'IT Security')

skillNames.description: Skill name per scenario-local tell id, for the result breakdown (built-in tells keep theirs)

tellStrings.description: Red-flag sentence per scenario-local tell id, for the review card (built-in tells keep theirs; a message's factorStrings still win)

labels.description: Wording over the defaults (triage-kinds.js 'kindLabel'): any key left out keeps its default.

kind.description: Short kind words by kind: email, sms, voicemail, qr, page, call, push, choice

choice.description: Wording of an authored-choice card (triage-kinds.js CHOICE_TEXT): brief, group, answered, right, wrong, better, whyRight, ifWrong

verdict.description: Email verdict buttons and brief legend by trust, report, delete, verify: { label?, past?, hint? }

callActions.description: By action id comply, escalate, refuse, verify_callback

pushActions.description: By action id approve, deny, deny_report

smsHeading.description: The 'Text message' heading on a text (default 'Text message')

queue.description: The brief's wording by queue: inbox, call, push, callPush, voicemail, page, sms, choice, other

comparison.description: 05 N11: the pre/post panel after a post round; false turns it off

requires.description: social.intelFacts ids that must all be held before the prep card shows this line (P3 N9); gate the ink choice on the same facts

doneGlobal.description: The report reads this global as 'an ask was granted'. Default: the call's pretext_<callId>_outcome is got_it (or the lab's pretext_call_done)

reportedGlobal.description: The report reads this global as 'the contact reported it'. Default: the call's pretext_<callId>_outcome is reported (or the lab's <character>_reported)

prepLabels.description: Wording of the preparation overlay; each defaults to today's text. approachTitle is the title for an in-person call (default: title).

tells.description: Reserved keys techniques, repair, ask, bands; every other key is a fact id in knows

socialEngagementReportItem.description: A results-step item in the engagement report: confirm (press to acknowledge) or question (opt-in; options with one correct, report-model.js)

socialEngagementBoardBlock.description: A scope or plan board mode (board-model.js)

effect.description: fire: an irregular warm flicker with small rising flame tongues (flash-safe, still under reduced motion)

flames.description: fire only: how many flame tongues rise across the glow (default 6, 0 none)

leds.description: Rack-style blinking status LEDs on the object's face (density 0-1; 0 none). Lets a mission's own rack art blink like the stock racks

above.description: Draw the glow above the light map in a lit room too (small indicators that must stay visible)

hueKeep.description: above glows only: false turns off the multiply under the glow that keeps its hue in a lit room (default on)

floorTint.description: In a lit room, tint the floor in front of the object with its glow colour (0 = off)

aimsCompleted.description: Array variant of aimCompleted -- unlocks when ALL listed aims are completed

missionConclusion.description: When true, completing this aim records mission_concluded_at on the server. At most one aim per scenario should have this flag.

concludeRequires.description: Server-side ending gate. The CLIENT decides when the story is over (it owns the debrief and the credits); this declares the technical work the server will not let the story skip. Gate on the large technical achievements only -- the VM and CTF work the mission exists to teach. Do NOT list story tasks: story progress is scored, not gated. Micro-managing it here withholds the ending for narrative bookkeeping, and a story task with a single completion route becomes an unannounced dead end -- that is exactly how a finished m02 run was stranded in in_progress forever. Omit the field entirely to trust the client outright, which is right when there is no large technical work to gate on.

tasksCompleted.description: Task IDs that must be completed. The server-authoritative form: flag-submission task records are written only after the flag is validated against the scenario's targetFlags. Use this for VM/CTF work.

globals.description: Global variables that must be true. Client-reported, so the weaker form -- use for story state, not for gating technical work.

conclusionScreen.description: Defines which overlay to show when the mission concludes. Used on first completion (if not already shown by triggerOnInteract) and on reload.

type.description: Chosen per scenario. bond_visualiser: the credits (the fullscreen audio visualiser); story missions use this, with the credits rolled from a music event. success: a simple success screen (title, optional body, Return to missions, Close) for short training episodes; it waits until no minigame is open, shows once per page load and can be closed. end_screen: the old blocking mission-complete card, for test and demo scenarios only.

bondVisualiserOpts.description: Options forwarded to BondVisualiser.open() when type is bond_visualiser.

title.description: success and end_screen: the heading. Defaults to 'Exercise complete' (success) or 'MISSION COMPLETE' (end_screen).

body.description: success: one or two plain-text sentences under the title (optional). end_screen: HTML.

buttonText.description: success and end_screen: the label of the button that leaves the game. Defaults to 'Return to missions'.

optional.description: If true, this task does not block aim completion

targetItemIds.description: Specific item IDs (distinct from targetItems which matches item types)

targetGroup.description: Matches collection_group field on items for group-collection tracking

targetFlags.description: Array of flag identifiers to submit (e.g., ['desktop-flag1', 'kali-flag1'])

setGlobal.description: Global variables to set when this task completes

connections.description: Room connections (direction -> room_id or array of room_ids)

lockedHint.description: Opt-in: appended to the Requires key and wrong-key alerts of a locked key lock, to say where the key comes from (utils/locked-hint.js). Linted by scripts/validate_social/options.rb

lighting.description: Per-room lighting. 'motion': dark until the player or an NPC walks in. Rooms with people in them start lit unless startOn is false.

offAfter.description: Motion rooms: seconds after the player leaves before the lights go off.

emitters.description: Per-room changes to object glows, keyed by object id (checked first) or texture-key prefix. A list of variants; the first whose condition (globalVars syntax) holds wins. A single object is one variant.

variants.description: The room's lighting by game state (e.g. day and night). Each is a partial lighting block with an optional condition (globalVars syntax); the first that holds is merged over this block (emitters merge by key, the rest replaces). Re-checked as globals change and at load, and applied at once without a strike.

ambientSound.description: Audio asset key for ambient room sound

elevation.description: Optional elevation value (32 = 1 tile height) for z-ordering when objects need to appear in front of or behind other sprites

rfidCard.description: Keycard this NPC carries, readable by the player's RFID cloner. npc-conversation-state.js syncs card_protocol/card_name/card_card_id and the card_instant_clone/card_needs_attack/card_uid_only flags into the NPC's ink story; chat-helpers.js builds the cloned card from it.

card_id.description: Card identifier; matched against the card id in a #clone_keycard tag.

rfid_protocol.description: Protocol decides how the clone works: EM4100 and MIFARE_Classic_Weak_Defaults clone instantly, MIFARE_Classic_Custom_Keys needs a key attack, MIFARE_DESFire is UID-only. Defaults to EM4100 when cloning.

spriteStyle.description: Optional look laid over the NPC's world sprite (systems/npc-sprite-style.js), for holograms and ghosts such as m08's ATHENA. It holds through every animation and a knockout. alpha multiplies the engine's own alpha; glow is a postFX outline (WebGL) that, with light, also lights the room's light map round the NPC so dim rooms don't darken it; flicker is a rare flash-safe two-step dip, off under prefers-reduced-motion.

flicker.description: true: a brief flicker every few seconds and a slow shimmer of the glow.

light.description: With a glow: true (default) lights the floor round the NPC in the glow colour; false turns it off; or set radius (px, default 40), intensity (0-1, default 0.45) and color.

spriteVisemes.description: Optional lip-sync sheet (assets/characters/<key>_visemes.png, one row of mouth shapes) with a matching .json beside it naming each column. Falls back to spriteTalk when absent or unloadable.

portraitVariants.description: Optional alternative dialogue portraits (utils/portrait-variants.js), e.g. a knocked-out bust. Checked each time person-chat draws this NPC, and for the phone avatar: the first entry whose gates hold replaces spriteTalk / spriteVisemes / avatar (fields it leaves out keep the base value); none holding gives the base fields. An ink '# portrait:<name>' (or '# portrait:<npc_id>:<name>') forces a named entry for the rest of the conversation; '# portrait:base' forces the base fields.

name.description: Name for a '# portrait:<name>' tag. 'base' is reserved.

condition.description: globalVars condition (global-condition.js: !, ===, !==, <, >, &&, ||; no parentheses), e.g. "globalVars.torres_ko === true".

ko.description: true: only while this NPC is knocked out (combat state, or its globalVarOnKO global); false: only while it is not. With condition, both must hold. An entry with neither is reached only by name.

voice.description: TTS voice configuration for the NPC

fx.description: Optional Web Audio voice FX applied to this NPC's TTS (distortion/filtering). A preset name ('voice-distortion', 'radio', 'robot') or a custom object: { highpass, lowpass, drive, ringMod: { frequency, mix }, makeup }. See TTSManager.VOICE_FX_PRESETS.

initiallyHidden.description: If true, NPC is hidden until triggered by an event. Use for cutscene-only NPCs.

immovable.description: If true, sets Phaser.Physics.Arcade.Components.Immovable on the NPC body -- the NPC cannot be pushed by player or other collision forces. Use for stationary bed/chair NPCs.

hostile.description: Hostile configuration. Set to true (boolean) for default settings, or an object with chaseSpeed/attackDamage/pauseToAttack for custom values.

facePlayerDistance.description: Pixels within which the NPC turns to face the player (and a patrolling NPC with pauseForPlayer stops). Default 96; needs facePlayer (default true).

personalSpace.description: The NPC backs away when the player comes closer than distance. Off unless enabled.

collisionBox.description: Shrinks the physics body for static-sprite NPCs. 'bottom_half' restricts collision to the lower half of the sprite -- useful for tall prop-style NPCs where only the base should be solid.

torch.description: Lighting: the NPC carries a torch beam the way they face, shown only in a dim room. true, or { condition (globalVars syntax), color }.

observations.description: Descriptive text shown in the world UI hover label when the player looks at this NPC, and as flavour text in notes/minigames. Falls back to displayName if absent.

disableClose.description: If true, hides the close button and suppresses Esc for this NPC's conversation/minigame -- for forced cutscene-style interactions the player cannot skip.

los.description: Line-of-sight detection cone configuration. When enabled, the NPC can detect the player within the specified range and angle.

enabled.description: Activates LOS processing for this NPC

visualize.description: Draw the detection cone on screen

occlusion.description: Default true: walls, closed doors and tall props (npc-sight-occlusion.js) block this NPC's view and clip the drawn cone. false = sees through everything (range and angle only)

challengeOnSight.description: Opt-in (default off). When the player is in this NPC's room and inside his cone, emit an event (default player_spotted:<npcId>) once per sighting, at most once per cooldown. Map the event in eventMappings to a person-chat knot, setGlobal, bark or emitEvent. true = all defaults. See README_scenario_design.md, 'Guards who challenge on sight'.

enabled.description: Default true; false turns the challenge off

cooldown.description: Milliseconds before this NPC can challenge again (default 10000)

rooms.description: Only while the player is in one of these rooms (the NPC must be in the player's room as well)

requireGlobal.description: Only while this global is truthy (string), or while every listed global equals its value (object)

skipIfGlobal.description: Never while this global (or any of these globals) is truthy

restartOnRetalk.description: Default true: an NPC whose ink story has ended (-> END / -> DONE) restarts at its start knot when talked to again. Set false for one-shot scenes (final choices, confrontations, debriefs) that must not replay.

reopenRefreshesHub.description: Person-chat, opt-in, default false. A conversation closed on a topic's last line resumes part-way through that topic; if finishing it reaches the hub's choices with nothing said (an ink `quiet` flag the topic set), the hub is re-entered once so it shows its current line, not the old topic line (person-chat-reopen.js refreshHubAfterMidKnotReopen).

livePreview.description: Phone contact, opt-in, default false. For a looping hint hub: the contact list previews the line that opening the thread would add now (a dry run of the reopen under today's globals), instead of the thread's last line from the previous open (PhoneChatConversation.previewReopen).

gender.description: Optional. Picks the pronoun in the engine's hostile-NPC toast ("He's / She's past talking.", combat-input.js pastTalkingMessage). Without it the engine uses a male_/female_ sprite-sheet prefix, else "They're".

globalVarOnKO.description: Name of global variable to set to true when this NPC is knocked out. Must be defined in scenario.globalVariables.

taskOnKO.description: Task ID to complete when this NPC is knocked out. Must exist in objectives.

koImmune.description: true: the player can't fight or knock out this NPC. Punches pass over it without turning it hostile.

callId.description: When set, talking to this NPC opens pretext-prep for this social.pretextNpcs call instead of plain dialogue. The character's person channel is this NPC.

phoneTheme.description: Optional visual theme for the phone-chat minigame. 'terminal' uses a black-screen CRT aesthetic with phosphor green text.

waitForEvent.description: Event pattern to wait for before sending this timed message
Event pattern to wait for before starting the conversation

skipIfGlobal.description: Name of a global variable -- if true, skip this conversation. Prevents briefing replay on resume. See m01_first_contact for usage.

setGlobalOnStart.description: Name of a global variable to set to true when conversation starts. Used with skipIfGlobal to mark as seen.

delayMs.description: Run the whole mapping this many ms after the event. Checks run at the event and again when the delay is up (a condition that stopped holding cancels it); waits for an open minigame or conversation to close.

fireOnlyWhenLoaded.description: Validator opt-out, no effect in the game. An NPC outside the start room only listens once its room has loaded, so a global change, pickup, KO or objective event that fires earlier passes unheard, and the validator warns. Set true when missing the event is acceptable (a reaction that only matters if the player is in the room).

bark.description: Text to bark above the NPC with a speech bubble (and TTS if NPC has voice)

barkDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait before showing the bark (default 0). Use to stagger multi-NPC responses.

conversationMode.description: Trigger a cutscene. 'person-chat' opens a full-screen overlay. 'phone-chat' opens the phone-chat minigame. 'video-call' opens the person-chat overlay framed as a secure video call with a player self-view PiP (works for phone NPCs too). All require targetKnot.

disableClose.description: If true, player cannot close this conversation

patrolOverride.description: Override current patrol -- NPC walks directly to targetTile

setPatrolSpeed.description: Change the NPC's patrol speed (pixels/second) from this point on

setDwellMultiplier.description: Multiply all patrol waypoint dwell times (e.g. 0.3 = 30% of normal pause)

setVisible.description: Show or hide the NPC sprite

type.description: Sprite name for this item. Any valid sprite asset name is accepted. Certain types have special engine behaviour: 'pc' (file container), 'safe'/'suitcase'/'briefcase'/'bin'/'bin1' (locked containers), 'vm-launcher' (VM terminal), 'launch-device' (launch/abort prop), 'flag-station' (flag submission), 'lockpick'/'key'/'keycard'/'rfid_cloner'/'pin-cracker'/'bluetooth_scanner'/'fingerprint_kit' (security tools), 'notes'/'notes2'/'notes4'/'notes5'/'text_file'/'chalkboard' (readable content). Can be combined with 'observations' for any sprite.

id.description: This object's own unique identity, distinct from opens_lock (which names the lock it opens). Used to target this specific object.

blocksSight.description: true: this prop blocks NPC sight like a wall; false: it never does. Unset: tall racks, shelving, cabinets, lockers and vending machines block (npc-sight-occlusion.js)

position.description: Position of the object. Can be coordinates {x, y, elevation?} or 'as-type:typename' to use another type's placement slots.

elevation.description: Optional elevation value (32 = 1 tile height) for z-ordering when objects need to appear in front of or behind other sprites

oneOf.description: Use placement slots of another type (e.g., 'as-type:pc' to place a laptop at PC positions)

observationDisplay.description: Display mode for observation text: 'gameDisplay' for modal dialog, or omit for toast notification

readDisplay.description: For readable objects fixed in place (signs, boards, plaques, device panels): 'gameDisplay' shows the text in a modal instead of opening it as a notebook page.

addToNotes.description: With readDisplay: false stops the text being saved to the player's notes (flavour, or live displays whose text changes). Default true.

observationVariants.description: Optional runtime observation variants resolved in order by condition against globalVars.

spriteVariants.description: Optional runtime sprite variants resolved in order by condition against globalVars. Overrides the default sprite texture when a condition matches.

textVariants.description: Optional runtime readable text variants resolved in order by condition against globalVars.

ttsVoice.description: Text-to-speech voice config for phone voicemail items

sprite.description: Override sprite for this item (e.g., on vm-launcher or launch-device)

collection_group.description: Groups items for task.targetGroup tracking. Items sharing a collection_group are tracked together.

onRead.description: Actions to fire when the item is read

setVariable.description: Global variables to set when item is read. Must be defined in scenario.globalVariables.

onPickup.description: Actions to fire when the item is picked up

setVariable.description: Global variables to set when item is picked up. Must be defined in scenario.globalVariables.

opens_lock.description: The lock this item opens -- a reference to a lock's 'requires' value, NOT this item's own name. Many-to-one: two spare keys to the same door share one opens_lock and keep distinct 'id's. If the value does not name a lock, it is an identity and belongs in 'id'.

key_id.description: DEPRECATED -- renamed to 'opens_lock'. Read by the engine only so missions started before the rename can finish; the validator errors on it in a scenario file.

lockedHint.description: Opt-in: appended to the Requires key and wrong-key alerts of a locked key lock, to say where the key comes from (utils/locked-hint.js). Linted by scripts/validate_social/options.rb

hintOnlyFlags.description: Flag reference => hint message. A flag listed here is validated but not submitted or scored; the station just shows the message (used when a flag is spent elsewhere). Server-side only, stripped from the client scenario.

onAbort.description: Actions to fire when launch is aborted

onLaunch.description: Actions to fire when launch is confirmed

abortConfirmText.description: Player-facing text for the abort confirmation dialog on launch-device

launchConfirmText.description: Player-facing text for the launch confirmation dialog on launch-device

triggerOnInteract.description: Actions fired when player interacts with this object

fact.description: grant_fact: the social intel fact id (00 S15)

onConfirm.description: Actions to execute on confirmation (for confirm_action)

level.description: lighting_dip: how far the lights sag (0.5 = half)

objectId.description: Object id to unlock client- and server-side (used with type: 'unlock_object'). Already implemented by apply-actions.js/process_flag_rewards; this enum entry was missing from the schema.

key.description: Global variable name to set (used with type: 'set_global')

value.description: Value to assign to the global variable (used with type: 'set_global')
